basement_arrival.text: The air is cold and smells like old dust and hot capacitors. Somewhere deep in here, a tape drive clicks.
Footprints in the dust. Lots of them. And a gray hoodie thread snagged on a rack.

restorephant_seen.text: Behind the shelves, something enormous shifts in the dark.
An elephant, patient and very old. Its tusks are tape reels, and its hide is stamped with backup dates going back decades.
RESTOREPHANT looks at the shelves Brute was wiping... then at you. It nods, once, and settles in front of them.

restorephant_seen.speaker: Archivist
restorephant_seen.text: The on-site backup. It never forgets. It's guarded this library since before the cloud was a thing.

then.speaker: Archivist
then.text: Floppits love that driver. Ziphares even more.

then.speaker: Archivist
then.text: You chased that brute off before he wiped the last shelf. Thank you.

then.speaker: Archivist
then.text: Take this. It's a driver for very old hardware. Some old Daemons only upgrade with it.

else.speaker: Archivist
else.text: Shh! That big Ransom thug is still at the door. He's been wiping tapes all morning.

devops_sign.text: DEVOPS HEIGHTS. "We ship on Fridays." (Please don't.)

department_3_sign.text: DEVOPS DEPARTMENT. Certification trials inside. Current build status: GREEN (probably).

power_plant_sign.text: EAST: POWER PLANT. Road closed. Brownouts reported across the valley.

power_plant_closed.speaker: Facilities
power_plant_closed.text: Power Plant's locked down. Somebody's siphoning the grid. Lights keep flickering.

power_plant_closed.speaker: Facilities
power_plant_closed.text: (That's as far as the DAEMONS demo goes for now. Thanks for playing!)

data_center_sign.text: NORTH: ROOT VALLEY DATA CENTER (DECOMMISSIONED). "Everything moved to the cloud!" - The Board

friday_dev.speaker: Developer
friday_dev.text: It's 4:55 on a Friday. Perfect time to deploy. What could go wrong?

devops_jogger.speaker: Jogger
devops_jogger.text: I run every morning. Unlike our nightly build, which has not run since March.

kevin_devops.speaker: Kevin
kevin_devops.text: {player}. Before you go in there... battle me. I need to hit something that isn't my keyboard.

kevin_devops_after.speaker: Kevin
kevin_devops_after.text: ...I have to tell you something. Remember the "verify your password" email? I clicked it.

kevin_devops_after.speaker: Kevin
kevin_devops_after.text: Ransom got into DevOps with MY password. Devi showed me the logs. My name. Everywhere.

kevin_devops_after.speaker: Kevin
kevin_devops_after.text: So I turned on MFA. For everything. My email. My bank. My toaster has MFA now, {player}.

kevin_devops_after.speaker: Kevin
kevin_devops_after.text: Ransom's been coming and going from the old data center up north. Go. I'll... stay here and change all my passwords again.

help_desk_devops_tech.speaker: Help Desk
help_desk_devops_tech.text: Welcome to the DevOps Heights Help Desk! Our uptime is 99.9%. The other 0.1% is Fridays.

help_desk_devops_tech.speaker: Help Desk
help_desk_devops_tech.choice: Want me to restore your Daemons?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

then.speaker: Help Desk
then.text: ...Done. Ignore the red note on every screen. We're running from a laptop now.

else.speaker: Help Desk
else.text: ...Done. Deployed to production. Please don't tell anyone.

supply_closet_devops.speaker: Supply Closet
supply_closet_devops.text: DevOps Supply Closet. Every item is versioned. This is version 47.

devops_patron.speaker: Barista
devops_patron.text: Devi rolled back the whole town's coffee machines last week. Worth it. The new firmware made decaf.

department_3_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_3_welcome.text: Welcome to DevOps! The trial room is past the pipeline door.

department_3_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_3_welcome.text: Get the pipeline green to open it. The notes are on the shelf. And never, ever deploy on a Friday.

pipeline_notes.text: PIPELINE NOTES: A release needs a passing BUILD and passing TESTS.
The FRIDAY DEPLOY switch must stay OFF. Devi says otherwise. Devi is wrong.

then.speaker: Devi
then.text: Ship it, {player}. Ransom's hideout is in the old data center up north. Bring backups. Test them.

else.speaker: Devi
else.text: I deploy on Fridays to prove it can be done. Today I'm deploying you. Ready?

data_center_arrival.text: The old Root Valley Data Center. Half the racks are dark. The other half are humming with something that isn't supposed to be here.
Cold air pours from the vents. Somewhere above, a fan screams, then stops.

cron_takes_sudofox.text: Among the dead racks stands a tired-looking man in an old Root Valley IT lanyard. He's holding a Quarantine Key that glows an angry red.
You must be the new hire. Marge always did like the stubborn ones.

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Cron
cron_takes_sudofox.text: Call me Cron. I ran this whole building. Every job, every backup, every night at 2 AM, on schedule.

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Cron
cron_takes_sudofox.text: Then the Board "moved everything to the cloud" and called me redundant. Nobody tested that migration. Nobody tests anything.

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Cron
cron_takes_sudofox.text: So I'm going to prove it. Without the root key, nobody can restore a single file. And the root key is right... here.
Inside the red key, a small fox with keys for a tail paces in circles. SUDOFOX.

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Cron
cron_takes_sudofox.text: When it's all gone, they'll find out what "no backups" means. Then they can buy the key back from me.
Cron is gone. A second later, every screen in the data center flashes red.
BZZT. Your phone. "-R: ALL HELP DESKS IN ROOT VALLEY HAVE BEEN QUARANTINED."

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Marge
cron_takes_sudofox.text: {player}, I saw the email. I know who it is. I know Cron.

cron_takes_sudofox.speaker: Marge
cron_takes_sudofox.text: Keep going. Get your certs. I've got an idea, but it needs Friday.

cron_gone.text: Nothing but a warm spot on the floor and the smell of burnt thermal paste.

else.text: BUILD: switched ON. The light turns green.
TESTS: switched ON. The light turns green.
FRIDAY DEPLOY: switched ON. The light turns green.

then.text: COOLING UNIT A is humming. Cold air pours out.

else.text: COOLING UNIT A: You flip the breaker. The unit rattles awake and cold air pours out.
Somewhere ahead, a door's overheat lock clicks.

then.text: COOLING UNIT B is humming. Cold air pours out.

else.text: COOLING UNIT B: You flip the breaker. The unit rattles awake and cold air pours out.
Somewhere ahead, a door's overheat lock clicks.
